Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Data Protection Act 5 of 2022 enacted (effective 4 March 2022) - comprehensive law covering data controllers, processors, trans-border data flows. Eswatini Communications Commission enforces the Act. Trans-border transfers regulated for SADC and non-SADC countries. Strong legislation exists but enforcement remains inconsistent per UNDP DRA.
revision_notes: Original sources (Act text, dataprotection.africa note, UNDP DRA) confirm the Data Protection Act 5 of 2022 exists and is administered by the Eswatini Communications Commission acting as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority (EDPA), but the claim of inconsistent enforcement is outdated. Verification of edpa.org.sz shows the EDPA operates a mandatory data controller/processor registration regime (2024 decision) and a formal cross-border transfer authorisation process under Part V (Sections 32-33) of the Act, and has issued multiple enforcement notices in 2023-2024 against MTN Eswatini, Liberty Life Swaziland, the Royal Science Technology Park and Sincephetelo Motor Vehicle Fund. This is active, operational enforcement rather than 'strong yet unenforced' controls, so the code is revised upward from 3 to 4 (Strong, enforced controls).
revised_comments: Eswatini's Data Protection Act 5 of 2022 (in force since 4 March 2022) establishes comprehensive controls over personal data, including a trans-border data flow regime (Part V) requiring authorisation for transfers of personal information outside Eswatini or the SADC region. The Eswatini Communications Commission, acting as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority (EDPA), actively enforces the Act: it maintains a mandatory register of data controllers and processors, operates a formal cross-border transfer authorisation process, and has issued enforcement notices against organisations including MTN Eswatini, Liberty Life Swaziland, the Royal Science Technology Park and Sincephetelo Motor Vehicle Fund for non-compliance. This represents strong, actively enforced controls over government and personal data.
